perks.name: Keep Away

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Without a standalone reload perk Vantage Point feels a little lackluster. Keep Away does give a sizable reload boost coupled with a reload MW or loader mods on your gauntlets you can make this weapon feel pretty quick. Stats for All does work with Jolting Feedback to instantly get you to max stacks after applying Jolt which is a nifty trick. Eddy Current’s buff to instantly apply the benefits when amplified is great but if you're using Prismatic or just using Jolting Feedback for add clear and aren't investing into Arc you're better off with either of the other perks." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Adaptive frame pulse rifles have fallen off a bit with the exception of Bygones which will be toned down by the time this releases. Keep Away and Headseeker are great neutral perks but Vantage Point really exists as a neutral weapon. There are good damage perks like Swashbuckler that moves the needle to allow for a clean 6c kill but there are also better pulses that can two burst." Recommended MW: Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 119 from 22 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6CEZXurwhqejVZpX506M2a?si=7ef44c5f06ae4412) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways, and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing beefier Minor and Major enemies in both general and end-game, underleveled content, particularly with arc builds. Insurmountable is an arc adaptive Pulse Rifle with overall in-band stats. At base, 42 Range equates to 32.55m when ADS, 40 Handling is 0.42s ready, 0.38s ADS speed and 0.41s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 42 is a 2.01s reload. You might find a little help with the recoil direction useful or, if you can handle it, look for some extra handling or stability. In the magazine perk slot, look to increase magazine size and reload speed. But what makes this weapon special is the combination of Eddy Current to boost reload and handling when procced, and the new-to-season-25 Jolting Feedback trait which will passively apply Jolt to targets after 15 hits on enemies (or 11 when amplified) - great for additional chunk damage on a target and clearing nearby adds with the AoE damage. The Dark Ether origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows your weapon to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod, or possibly a Synergy (for Ionic Traces to proc Amplified more often), Tactical or Ammo Finder Enhancement mod when enhanced.

Adamsdown_Boy written v8.1.0.2 (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice utility PvE pick for dealing with constructs and vehicles in both general and end-game, underleveled content. Insurmountable is an arc adaptive Pulse Rifle with overall in-band stats. At base, 42 Range equates to 32.55m when ADS, 40 Handling is 0.42s ready, 0.38s ADS speed and 0.41s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 42 is a 2.01s reload. You might find a little help with the recoil direction useful or, if you can handle it, look for some extra handling or stability. In the magazine perk slot, look to increase magazine size and reload speed. If you're facing enemy vehicles or constructs, then Deconstruction in the first trait column for a ×1.4 damage boost and a 10% magazine reload after hitting around four bursts, pairs multiplicatively with either High-Impact Reserves for an escalating further damage boost up to ×1.256 (if you target dosn't have a crit spot) or Focused Fury's ×1.2 damage boost (if it does) when you're firing continuously at a single contruct or vehicle target. It's a shame this isn't a Häkke frame for even more construct/vehicle damage, but the Dark Ether origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows your weapon to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod, or possibly a Synergy (for Ionic Traces to proc Amplified more often), Tactical or Ammo Finder Enhancement mod when enhanced.
